Produced by Suriya and Jyothika's 2D Entertainment and the newly established Zhagaram Studios, the film stars Suriya, Naslen and Nazriya Nazim, with Anandaraj, Lal, Rajpriyan, Suresh Mathiyalagan and Gajaraj in supporting roles. It revolves around a DSP being forced to reopen an unfinished case and solve it with a troublesome team.

title: Mookuthi Amman 2
starring: Nayanthara in dual role, Regena Cassandrra and Duniya Vijay
story:
Mookuthi Amman 2 (transl. Nose-Ring Goddess 2) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language fantasy action thriller film directed and co-written by Sundar C. It is jointly produced by Vels Film International, Avni Cinemax and Rowdy Pictures. A spiritual successor to Mookuthi Amman (2020), the film stars Nayanthara in dual role, Regena Cassandrra and Duniya Vijay (in his Tamil debut) with Urvashi, Ramachandra Raju, Sunil, Myna Nandhini, Ineya, Yogi Babu and others in supporting roles.

title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
director: Ram and produced by Suresh Kamatchi
story:
Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai (transl. Seven Seas, Seven Hills) is a 2024 Indian Tamil-language romantic fantasy thriller film written and directed by Ram and produced by Suresh Kamatchi. It stars Nivin Pauly, Soori and Anjali. The film's score and soundtrack album were composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja, with cinematography and editing handled by N. K. Ekambaram and Mathi V. S., respectively.

title: Adaikalam
story: Adaikalam ( transl. Shelter) is a 2006 Indian Tamil-language drama film directed by A.R.Puvanaraaja and produced by N. Sri Narayanathas for Kaladas Creations. The film stars Prashanth, Uma, Thiagarajan, Radha Ravi and Saranya with a score composed by Sabesh–Murali. The film was released on 29 December 2006.
